aliases: Mississippi Center for Supercomputing Research data center
status_detail: University of Mississippi operates data center infrastructure supporting MCSR and UM research data services; architect project page describes a 20,767-square-foot secure data center opening with 500 kW capacity and room to expand to 1 MW, plus renovation of an existing 17,000-square-foot data center.
notes: Included because Ole Miss official pages reference UM Data Center infrastructure protecting MCSR-administered research storage and MCSR provides statewide IHL computing resources from Oxford/Lafayette County. The 500 kW/20,767 sf detail comes from the project architect page, not a county incentive announcement.

status_detail: Compass Datacenters announced a $10 billion hyperscale data center campus in Meridian/Lauderdale County on January 9, 2025. The campus is planned for eight data centers over eight years; Lauderdale County posted in July 2026 that construction of the data campus will employ more than 1,000 Mississippi workers and generate hundreds of permanent positions.
notes: MDA/Governor and Compass releases say Mississippi Power will supply approximately 500 MW; city of Meridian, Lauderdale County, EMBDC, Mississippi Power and MDA are assisting. Location is tied to Meridian I-20/59 Industrial Park in official economic-development quotes.

project_name: BancorpSouth Jackson Street Campus data center expansion
aliases: BancorpSouth data and information processing center
status_detail: The Tupelo/Lee County Community Development Foundation announced August 22, 2019 that BancorpSouth Bank was increasing capacity at its Jackson Street Campus in Tupelo, a more than $15 million investment creating 100 jobs. Area Development reported the campus was designated by MDA as a data and information processing center.
notes: CDF is the local chamber and economic development organization for Tupelo/Lee County. Included as an enterprise/bank data center/data processing campus rather than a hyperscale colocation project; BancorpSouth later combined with Cadence Bank, but the 2019 project developer was BancorpSouth.
